items.headline: Jake Fette throws, catches a TD pass in Arizona State's 20-10 win over Colorado
items.description: — Jake Fette became the first Arizona State quarterback in 30 years to throw and catch a touchdown pass in the same game and the Sun Devils held on to beat Colorado 20-10 on Saturday night.
